operation.name: InsertGBVAttachment
GetGBVAttachments
operation.query:
SELECT [GBVAttachmentID] ,[GBVMainID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID]
FROM [GBVAttachment] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [GBVMainID] = @GBVMainID order by [GBVAttachmentID] ASC

operation.name: DeleteGBVAttachment
operation.query:
IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT GBVAttachmentID FROM GBVAttachment WHERE DELETED = 0 AND GBVMainID = @GBVMainID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0;
ELSE
BEGIN
UPDATE [GBVAttachment] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID
UPDATE [GBVMain] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[ConsentSigned] = 0 WHERE GBVMainID = @GBVMainID
SET @ReturnValue = 1;
END

operation.name: GetGBVAttachment
operation.query:
SELECT top 1 [GBVAttachmentID] ,[GBVmainID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID]
FROM [GBVAttachment] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [GBVMainID] = @GBVMainID order by GBVAttachmentID desc
